ClaudeDevs: 'You can now build custom themes for Claude Code on desktop with mods! Change the colors, add an animated background, and make it your own. Just tell Claude how you want it to look, or get started quickly with the theme-examples plugin. We'd love to see what you make!'

ClaudeDevs: 'We've made some big updates to Projects in Claude Code! In a project, Claude coordinates your tasks across parallel threads. The coordinator is now much more proactive. It answers your questions in the project chat and gives you updates on the status of your ongoing threads.'

MengTo: 'This is such an insane workflow. 5% Tripo3D, Blender, and Claude Opus 5.5. The workflow in English, from Kamome Ashizawa's (葦沢かもめ) write-up: 1. Give Claude 3 reference images and a short backstory 2. Harness: CLAUDE.md plus subagents for planning,'

garrytan: 'Keep Opus 5.5 as your coding default in Claude Code. On 52 coding tasks in Claude Code 2.1.322, Fable 5.2 solved about as many (82.7% vs 84.6%) but cost 2.80x as much per solved task. Opus already solves most of these tasks, though, so telling the two apart will take harder'
